answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 164476 Country: India Title: Can we name our daughter Ayesha Suhana? Question: Can we name our daughter Ayesha Suhana? Answer ID: 164476 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1265/1008/SN=01/1440) You may keep the name Ayesha Suhana. However, if you add Siddiqah instead of Suhana and keep the name Ayesha Siddiqah then it is far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
